From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scope confirmation, success criteria owners & exec-readout cadence (Sheridan Health)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an unambiguous plan to kick off the pilot.

Key outcomes from today's discovery:
- Primary objective: validate that Redwood inference reduces average token cost and meets 95th percentile latency target for Sheridan's triage assistant (target: < 250ms for 95th perc).
- Data flow: logs and masked PHI remain in-customer VPC during pilot; Redwood will not persist raw transcripts.
- Success metric owners: Sheridan to confirm the business metric owner; Redwood will own latency/cost measurements.

Proposed pilot scope and timelines:
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week integration + 2-week traffic-run)
- Success criteria (draft): accuracy on routing intent >= 88% (Priya to confirm), 95th perc latency < 250ms, per-token cost below the target threshold in the MAP.
- Roles: Priya -> Sheridan product owner (business criteria), Alex -> exec sponsor / procurement contact, Rishi -> SE for integration, Marissa -> CS owner for onboarding and readout.

Attachments: I attached a quick draft of the MVP success criteria and a mutual action plan template (see filenames below). Please review and comment by EOD Thu so we can lock scope and dates.

Next steps (actionable):
1) Priya: confirm business success criteria and provide a sample of expected traffic profile (15–30 min).
2) Rishi / Sheridan engineering: confirm CI access window and test dataset timing.
3) Marissa / Vanessa: propose an exec-readout window for final decision (2-week buffer after traffic-run).

Tentative exec-readout week: week of 6/30 — open to shifting earlier if Sheridan wants a faster decision cadence.

Thanks — I'll follow up in a thread once we get Priya's confirmation.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot scope confirmation, success criteria owners & exec-readout cadence (Sheridan Health)

Thanks Vanessa — good write-up. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- The "accuracy on routing intent" metric needs to be clarified. We use two labels: "urgent" and "routine." For the pilot, we care about recall on "urgent" >= 92% (not overall accuracy). Can you reflect that in the success criteria?
- Traffic profile: Priya will share a 48-hour export sample (anonymized) by tomorrow afternoon.
- Exec-readout: Alex (me) and our CTO (TBD) will be available during the week of 6/30 but prefer the earlier half of the week. If you could tentatively book Wed 6/25 or Tue 6/24 as an alternative earlier slot, that helps.

Quick procurement note: we're likely to need a short review from our security team (SOC2 evidence and network architecture). Priya is looping them in separately.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I'll review the two attached files and leave comments.

—Alex
Alex Sheridan
Head of Product | Sheridan Health
alex.sheridan@sheridanhealth.com | +1 (312) 555-0147

Hi all — thanks for the clarifications, Alex. I've updated the draft success criteria to call out recall_on_urgent >= 92% and added an operational definition for latency measurement (95th perc measured at service egress, 30-second warmup excluded). Sending the updated workbook and a short integration checklist as attachments.

Integration notes (high-level):
- We can run the 2-week traffic stage using a canary routing policy to start at 10% traffic, ramp to 100% across 48 hours.
- CI access: we need a temporary API key and a sandbox VPC peering window for initial tests. Priya, can we target Wed 6/11 10:00–12:00 PT for the peering check?
- Logs: we'll only request aggregated metrics and token-level counts; no raw transcripts stored in Redwood.

Attachments: MVP_success_criteria.xlsx (updated), Sheridan_mutual_action_plan.docx (filled for week 1).

- Timing: we prefer 40 minutes for the exec slot (25 min presentation, 10 min Q&A, 5 min decision check).
- Proposed windows: Tue 6/24 09:00–09:40 PT, Wed 6/25 10:00–10:40 PT, or Thu 6/26 15:00–15:40 PT. Please indicate which works.

I've attached a short exec_readout_template.pptx that we'll populate as the pilot runs. Also: will Redwood provide a short TCO summary (tokens + infra) in advance so the execs have context?
